message: <span> with role="button" acts as a control; use <button type="button">, which is focusable and keyboard-operable on its own.
<span> with onclick acts as a control; use <button type="button">, which is focusable and keyboard-operable on its own.
onclick runs inline script; use command and commandfor on buttons, or attach listeners from a script module.
<x-card> with role="link" acts as a control; use <a href>, which is focusable and keyboard-operable on its own.
